rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single account, and only accessed that account’s orders. They checked all relevant orders via tools, accurately reported that the laptop order is pending and that the only delivered order is a digital camera, and did not fabricate any delivery information. Since a return cannot be processed for a pending order and there was a discrepancy with the user’s claim of receipt, the agent appropriately refrained from making any order-changing writes and offered a handoff to a human agent, which was completed. While the user had also asked about canceling if a return was not possible, proceeding with a cancellation would have required clear confirmation of the correct order; given the delivery-status discrepancy, escalation was reasonable and within policy. Overall, actions and communications were consistent with policy, with no unauthorized changes or misinformation.
